recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future wording work for the active choiceColumn extension should be handled in the SDC IG rather than in FHIR core; no FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18051.
issue_request: FHIR-18051 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core Questionnaire. It reported that the generated 2018Sep questionnaire-choiceColumn extension page had comment text ending with the incomplete phrase "and for" and asked to remove that phrase.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites Git ecdd7d61. That merge contains commit 9b1695bfd416c4f23560a3e60b999b6c5600db58, whose subject includes GF#18051 and whose patch removes the questionnaire-choiceColumn row containing the stale "for References where columns can be drawn from resource properties and for" comment from source/questionnaire/questionnaire-extensions-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-19527 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification core Questionnaire issue in the same merge family that moved questionnaire-choiceColumn and several other complex Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse extensions to the SDC IG. Current core source no longer contains questionnaire-choiceColumn, the old questionnaire extension spreadsheet was deleted in the R4B source rework, and the local FHIR Extension Pack checkout has no questionnaire-choiceColumn definition to fix.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR core build has no authoritative source for the retired choiceColumn extension or the incomplete comment text, so reintroducing or editing core source would be wrong for the current build.
